def process(hyperactivated, fda_drugs) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    hyp = hyperactivated.copy()
    hyp['protein_norm'] = hyp['protein'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()

    fda = fda_drugs.copy()
    fda['gene_norm'] = fda['gene_name'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()

    # Keep only FDA-sourced interactions to match the question wording
    fda_fda = fda[fda['interaction_claim_source'].astype(str).str.upper().eq('FDA')].copy()

    merged = hyp.merge(fda_fda, left_on='protein_norm', right_on='gene_norm', how='inner')

    out = merged[['protein']].drop_duplicates().rename(columns={'protein': 'protein_site'})
    out = out.sort_values('protein_site').reset_index(drop=True)
    return out

def process(hyperactivated, fda_drugs) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    hyp = hyperactivated.copy()
    fda = fda_drugs.copy()

    # normalize symbols
    hyp['protein_norm'] = hyp['protein'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
    fda['gene_norm'] = fda['gene_name'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()

    # mmc6 sheet is titled 'FDA approved drugs' already; do NOT filter by interaction_claim_source
    merged = hyp.merge(fda, left_on='protein_norm', right_on='gene_norm', how='inner')

    out = (merged[['protein_norm', 'gene_name', 'drug_name']]
           .rename(columns={'protein_norm': 'protein'})
           .dropna(subset=['drug_name']))

    # Return unique proteins targeted by at least one drug
    res = (out.groupby('protein', as_index=False)
             .agg(fda_approved_drugs=('drug_name', lambda s: sorted(set(map(str, s))))))

    return res.sort_values('protein').reset_index(drop=True)

def process(hyperactivated, fda_drugs):
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np
    
    hyp = hyperactivated.copy()
    hyp['protein_norm'] = hyp['protein'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
    
    fda = fda_drugs.copy()
    fda['gene_norm'] = fda['gene_name'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
    
    # Keep only rows that are truly FDA-approved drugs: either explicit FDA source OR sheet title implies FDA-approved.
    # The sheet is already named 'G-FDA approved drugs', so include all but clean obvious junk.
    fda['drug_name_clean'] = fda['drug_name'].astype(str).str.strip()
    fda = fda[fda['drug_name_clean'].notna()]
    fda = fda[~fda['drug_name_clean'].isin(['', 'nan', 'NaN', 'None'])]
    # remove boolean-like artifacts
    fda = fda[~fda['drug_name_clean'].str.fullmatch('False|True', case=False, na=False)]

    merged = hyp.merge(fda, left_on='protein_norm', right_on='gene_norm', how='inner')

    out = (merged.groupby('protein_norm')['drug_name_clean']
           .apply(lambda s: sorted(set(s)))
           .reset_index())
    out.columns = ['protein_site', 'fda_approved_drugs']
    return out.sort_values('protein_site').reset_index(drop=True)
